title: Elden Ring
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. A user (highball-db#179, 2026-09-22) rated it 5, perfect, Apple M1, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.33, D3DMetal, 231 minutes played through Highball with the steam and vcrun2022 recipes. nimbold (highball-db#228, 2026-09-26): rated 5, perfect, Apple M3, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r10, Highball 0.9.37, D3DMetal with frame generation 2x and AVX advertised. MonuCarpenter (highball-db#324, 2026-10-05), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, the environment in DXMT mode, rated 5 of 5 after a five-minute session. mentirosodiyei (highball-db#617, 2026-10-21), Apple M4 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal environment, msync, AVX advertised, rated 5 of 5 after 11 minutes. PinkOatmeal (highball-db#886, 2026-11-01), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 40 minutes: sometimes low frame rates, which the reporter suspects is shaders compiling. txmaniac (highball-db#906, 2026-11-02), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.5.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 48 minutes: no frame drops, but the game can't be minimized and the mouse and keyboard can't move to another display while it runs. mehmetsedatovur (highball-db#1224, 2026-11-15), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 5 of 5 after 91 minutes: with D3DM_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION, D3DM_VENDOR_ID=0x106b, DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1, WINE_AGP_SIZE=16384 and a WINEDLLOVERRIDES line of their own in the environment. velhobit (highball-db#1252, 2026-11-15), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r30, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 9 minutes: the report names start_protected_game, and the player says Easy Anti-Cheat didn't work for them, so they replaced start_protected_game.exe with a renamed copy of the game's eldenring.exe to play offline, starting that exe from Highball or directly, not from Steam. They did that themselves. Alt+Tab didn't work until they changed the game's resolution.
notes: EAC is userspace under Wine — runs; use d3dmetal (D3D12) A reporter played 231 minutes on D3DMetal on an M1 with macOS 26.6.2 and rated it perfect, which is the longest session recorded for it here; frame rate not measured. A second perfect report on an M3 with macOS 27.0 and engine r10, D3DMetal with frame generation 2x. That reporter's controller was not recognised until they switched Wine's controller driver in the registry (HKCU\Software\Wine\WineBus, DisableHidraw=1 and Enable SDL=1), after which it worked. A third report, five minutes on an M4 Pro with the environment in DXMT mode, also perfect; too short to say more than that it starts and plays there. A fourth, 11 minutes on an M4 Max with D3DMetal and AVX advertised on engine r28, also perfect. Another perfect rating over 91 minutes on an M1 Pro on the default engine's r19, D3DMetal by the report (highball-db#1224). One player (highball-db#1252, M3 Pro, Wine 11 r30, DXMT) said the anticheat didn't work for them and replaced start_protected_game.exe with a renamed copy of the game's eldenring.exe to play offline. They did that themselves. Highball never changes game files and doesn't do this for anyone, and online play needs the anticheat. The other reports here start the game the normal way, mostly on D3DMetal.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

knownIssues.symptom: Controller not recognised (reported on an M3, macOS 27.0, engine r10).
knownIssues.cause: not measured. The reporter fixed it by switching Wine's controller driver from the system HID path to SDL.
knownIssues.fix: The dependency "Controllers through SDL" (recipe controller-sdl) sets Wine's controller driver to SDL only, the same two registry values the reporter set by hand. Restart the environment after applying. Reported working, not verified here.

knownIssues.symptom: Alt+Tab doesn't switch away from the game until the game's resolution is changed (M3 Pro, Wine 11 r30, DXMT, highball-db#1252). Another player couldn't minimize the game or move the mouse and keyboard to another display while it ran (M4 Pro, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#906)
